title: Quantum Vibes as a General Theory of Snack-Based Computing
abstract: This paper proposes that snacks improve computation because the vibes are immaculate.
body:
Introduction
We state that chips, crackers, and cookies create a new computing paradigm, but we provide no operational definition of improvement.

Method
The method section says we trusted the process. No protocol, measurement design, or comparison baseline is offered.

Results
The results section claims everyone felt more aligned after snacks. There are no numbers, no examples beyond slogans, and no distinction between morale and performance.

Discussion
The manuscript is intentionally funny and quotable. It has clear meme energy, but the argument does not cash out into anything testable.

Conclusion
Snacks are destiny.

Limitations
We admit nothing except that future work should continue to vibe.
